reviews.text: 2nd time going to this location. Parking is fine and the place is clean, bathrooms included. Staff was friendly and kids had fun. Should I have to pay about $30 per kid? No, over priced in my option...maybe $30 for 1st kid and some discount as you add more? Food was not bad at all. Definitely only something our family can do rarely for the price. Overall, fun and clean environment for kids!

Today 10/13/2025 at 1:25 pm I just left this place where they didn't help me because I don't speak English. There were 4 Latinos at the counter and they didn't want to help me buy the tickets. I don't recommend this place. The staff is unprofessional. They don't serve you. It's a disaster. I won't come back.

We had a great time here today. We were greeted with a friendly smile, our questions were answered patiently and checking in was easy. We had fun on the trampoline and with the claw machines. Thanks for the warm welcome.
